fields.heading: Your personal details have been updated
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

Your personal details for your Abundance account have been successfully updated.

If you did not make this change, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666 so that we can ensure the safety of your account.
